title: There's a red dot constantly lit in the bottom-right corner of my new monitor
description: The monitor I was given 2 weeks ago has a dead pixel, and it's very annoying.

worklogs.description: Ran a pixel test program and confirmed 1 dead pixel.
Called the Dell warranty line, the replacement was approved, and the shipment was initiated.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The dead pixel is outside tolerance, so Dell is sending a new monitor. They'll collect the old monitor when the shipment arrives.

resolutionNote: A monitor replacement was approved under warranty; the replacement unit was delivered to the user.
